FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh sack
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A swollen sack of flesh. These immobile flesh beasts serve as digestive organs. Place living creatures inside to continuously supply the hive with nutrition. They cannot digest inorganic matter, and when digestion is complete they will eject desiccated remains.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh block
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: An impassable lump of twisted flesh. It pulses and trembles, filled with terrible vitality. It can support a roof.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: chitin flesh block
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: An impassable lump of twisted flesh reinforced with hardened chitin. It pulses and trembles, filled with terrible vitality. It can support a roof.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh door
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A door grown from twisted flesh. It writhes open for approaching creatures and seals the passage behind them.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh barricade
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A waist-high, sturdy lump of twisted flesh used to stop incoming bullets. Though unsightly, it provides better cover than other low objects. Flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh hopper
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: An organ that allows the flesh hive to vomit out internally processed products. Through a flesh hopper, the hive can be ordered to consume nutrition and produce supplies.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: chitin flesh barricade
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A waist-high, sturdy lump of twisted flesh reinforced with hardened chitin. It is used to stop incoming bullets. Though unsightly, it provides better cover than other low objects. Chitin flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh lamp
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A spherical lump of flesh. These fleshbeast organs refine and store nutrition for nearby flesh masses. This chemical process makes them emit a soft bioluminescent glow.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh column
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A column made of flesh, used to support roofs. It does not block sight or movement.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh stool
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A simple stool made of flesh for people to sit on. It is unexpectedly comfortable. It can be used near dining tables, workbenches, or elsewhere.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh table (1x2)
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh table (2x2)
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh table (4x2)
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh table (3x3)
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh bed
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A single bed made of flesh. Soft flesh has grown into a pocket-like structure and a pillow for resting. It is unexpectedly comfortable, and those who rest on it recover from injuries more quickly.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh double bed
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A double bed made of flesh. Soft flesh has grown into a pocket-like structure and pillows for resting. It is unexpectedly comfortable, and those who rest on it recover from injuries more quickly.
